seasonalNotes: Hot summers (Mar–Jun, avg 32–35°C). Monsoon Jul–Sep across most of India (avoid waterlogged areas). Pleasant winters Oct–Feb (15–28°C). Heavy traffic in metros during peak hours (8–10 AM, 5–8 PM). Festival seasons: Diwali (Oct/Nov), Holi (Mar). Bangalore: Moderate climate year-round, occasional traffic gridlocks.
